stages.title: Learn a sparse task-sufficient configuration
stages.note: Train projection-specific gates and a linear POS readout while pretrained BERT weights remain fixed.

stages.title: Apply the permanent structural lesion
stages.note: Clamp selected Q/K/V head-sized groups and dense projection masks to -12.0 and block their gradients.

stages.title: Choose what the damaged system may adapt
stages.note: Every pathway begins from the same damaged configuration; permanently lesioned gates stay disabled.

stages.title: Compare behavior and representation
stages.note: Accuracy and similarity can recover by different amounts under different permitted adaptations.

core.label: Core
core.summary: Sparse task-sufficient configuration learned with fixed pretrained encoder weights.
core.implication: The learned gated configuration sustains near-95% POS accuracy.

damage.label: Damaged
damage.summary: Fixed residual network immediately after the structural lesion.
damage.implication: The original readout fails on the changed representation; NOUN dominates the residual accuracy.

mask_only_no_reg.label: Gates only · no penalty
mask_only_no_reg.summary: Surviving gates adapt without an explicit sparsity penalty; weights and readout stay fixed.
mask_only_no_reg.implication: Rerouting alone recovers part of the lost behavior and shifts geometry toward the core.

mask_only_reg.label: Gates only · sparse
mask_only_reg.summary: Surviving gates adapt under a sparsity-promoting objective; weights and readout stay fixed.
mask_only_reg.implication: A stronger sparsity constraint produces less recovery and marked seed sensitivity.

mask_only_inverse_reg.label: Gates only · density-promoting
mask_only_inverse_reg.summary: Surviving gate parameters adapt; pretrained encoder weights and the original POS readout remain fixed.
mask_only_inverse_reg.implication: The strongest gate-only route moves most toward core-like geometry but remains well below core accuracy.

readout_only.label: Readout only
readout_only.summary: The linear POS classifier adapts; encoder weights, gates, and the damaged representation remain fixed.
readout_only.implication: A new readout extracts substantial POS information without any encoder-representation change.

readout_and_mask_reg.label: Gates + readout
readout_and_mask_reg.summary: Surviving gates and the linear POS classifier adapt together; pretrained encoder weights remain fixed.
readout_and_mask_reg.implication: Joint adaptation outperforms either mechanism alone despite remaining closer to damaged than core geometry.

encoder_only.label: Encoder only
encoder_only.summary: Surviving pretrained encoder weights adapt; the lesion, gate configuration, and original POS readout remain fixed.
encoder_only.implication: The highest-capacity route nearly restores accuracy and global CKA, but not the original POS-centroid geometry.
